shared_elements: quadruped animal shown in profile with four legs
schematic anthropomorphic figure with limbs extended
carving/working of a natural stone surface
small-headed creatures with long thin appendages
justification: Both surfaces show schematic quadrupeds in profile alongside a roughly anthropomorphic figure, and both are worked directly into stone, which is the most specific correspondence available. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a deeply modelled, three-dimensional relief organised into stacked horizontal registers on a tall vertical monolith, while B is a flat, thin-lined pecked/pigmented linear composition of stick-like figures spread across a single horizontal field.
